mainEntity.name: Why is the traditional AI automation agency model fading?

acceptedAnswer.text: Traditional AI agencies relied on selling basic, generic automations. As corporate pilots failed to yield measurable ROI, businesses shifted toward custom, outcome-based internal consulting.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a freelance and an in-house Claude consultant?

acceptedAnswer.text: Freelance consultants enjoy schedule freedom and uncapped income potential but face client acquisition and revenue instability. In-house consultants gain steady paychecks, career longevity, and internal access to proprietary operational data.

mainEntity.name: Do I need coding experience to make money with Claude AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Claude consulting focuses on business problem identification, prompt engineering, structured workflow creation, and process documentation rather than writing custom software code.
